newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - LOCAL SHARES CONTINUE RUN.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - LOCAL SHARES CONTINUE RUN.

text.p: The Botswana Stock Exchange
continued its run over the 500 mark. The Domestic Companies
Index closed at 509.19 points, rising 7.54 points on the week.
Traded shares included Barclays , ending the week
up 10 thebe at 840 thebe; brewery holding company Sechaba
gaining 10 to close at 410; and milling company and
food wholesaler Sefalana trading unchanged at 510.
The market closed the week on a very strong note with a
number of the counters bid higher. Liquidity remains very tight.
Stocks untraded but bid higher were: Botswana Insurance
bid up 54 to 285; First National bid up 15 to
565; food and tobacco wholesaler Metsef bid up 5 to 680
and Standard Chartred bid up 10 to 695.
RDC Properties was unchanged at 180, Engen
bid down 5 to 445 and security group Inco bid
down 10 to 95.
Turnover and value traded was down over the week with
328,600 (487,700) shares changing hands for value 1,366,780
On the foreign board there was no trade. The index fell 0.56
of a point to 403.31 and stocks moved because of price movements
on the South African (Johannesburg) exchange.
Car rental and fleet management group Avis gained
15 to 693, De Beers gained 25 to 13,144; professional
services group Forbes gained 15 to 697; McCarthy Retail
group lost 1 to 1,020. Undervalued assets fund
Reent was unchanged at 4,000.
